## Description

```
Introducing Eden Cortex. A new era of Clinical Superintelligence.

Join Eden CEO Julián Ríos as he introduces a new generation of AI that goes from medical images to complete diagnostic reports, learning how radiologists work and reducing reading time by 30%.

Built on years of proprietary clinical data, Eden Cortex brings frontier AI directly into clinical practice. All within Eden PACS.

Join the waitlist: https://bit.ly/Eden-Cortex
```
